quranTranslation.text: And We said: O Adam! Dwell thou and thy wife in the Garden, and eat ye freely (of the fruits) thereof where ye will; but come not nigh this tree lest ye become wrong-doers.

explanation.bs: „…i ne prilazite ovom drvetu, pa da budete od nepravednika“ – posljedica zabrane, تَكُونَا u subjunktivu.
explanation.en: “…come not nigh this tree lest ye become wrong-doers” – the consequence of a prohibition, تَكُونَا subjunctive.

quranTranslation.text: Praise be to Allah, Lord of the Worlds,

explanation.bs: „Sva hvala pripada Allahu“ – ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ: hvala pripada Allahu.
explanation.en: “Praise be to Allah” – ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ: praise belongs to Allah.

quranTranslation.text: Unto Allah (belongeth) whatsoever is in the heavens and whatsoever is in the earth; and whether ye make known what is in your minds or hide it, Allah will bring you to account for it. He will forgive whom He will and He will punish whom He will. Allah is Able to do all things.

explanation.bs: „Allahu pripada sve što je na nebesima…“ – لِلَّهِ: posjed.
explanation.en: “Unto Allah (belongeth) whatsoever is in the heavens…” – لِلَّهِ: possession.

quranTranslation.text: That Allah may forgive thee of thy sin that which is past and that which is to come, and may perfect His favour unto thee, and may guide thee on a right path,

explanation.bs: „…da ti Allah oprosti…“ – يَغْفِرَ u subjunktivu.
explanation.en: “That Allah may forgive thee…” – يَغْفِرَ is subjunctive.

quranTranslation.text: I created the jinn and humankind only that they might worship Me.

explanation.bs: „Nisam stvorio džinne i ljude osim zato da Me obožavaju“.
explanation.en: “I created the jinn and humankind only that they might worship Me”.

quranTranslation.text: So let them worship the Lord of this House,

explanation.bs: „Neka, dakle, obožavaju Gospodara ove Kuće“ – يَعْبُدُوا u jusivu.
explanation.en: “So let them worship the Lord of this House” – يَعْبُدُوا is jussive.

quranTranslation.text: Let him who hath abundance spend of his abundance, and he whose provision is measured, let him spend of that which Allah hath given him. Allah asketh naught of any soul save that which He hath given it. Allah will vouchsafe, after hardship, ease.

explanation.bs: „Neka imućni troši od svog izobilja“.
explanation.en: “Let him who hath abundance spend of his abundance”.

quranTranslation.text: Who teacheth by the pen,

explanation.bs: „Koji je poučio perom“ – بِٱلْقَلَمِ.
explanation.en: “Who teacheth by the pen” – بِٱلْقَلَمِ.

quranTranslation.text: Allah had already given you the victory at Badr, when ye were contemptible. So observe your duty to Allah in order that ye may be thankful.

explanation.bs: „A Allah vas je već pomogao na Bedru“ – بِبَدْرٍ: na Bedru.
explanation.en: “Allah had already given you the victory at Badr” – بِبَدْرٍ: at Badr.

quranTranslation.text: Their likeness is as the likeness of one who kindleth fire, and when it sheddeth its light around him Allah taketh away their light and leaveth them in darkness, where they cannot see,

explanation.bs: „…Allah odnese njihovu svjetlost“ – ذَهَبَ ٱللَّهُ بِنُورِهِمْ.
explanation.en: “…Allah taketh away their light” – ذَهَبَ ٱللَّهُ بِنُورِهِمْ.

quranTranslation.text: Will not Allah defend His slave? Yet they would frighten thee with those beside Him. He whom Allah sendeth astray, for him there is no guide.

explanation.bs: „Zar Allah nije dovoljan Svome robu?“ – بِكَافٍ.
explanation.en: “Will not Allah defend His slave?” – بِكَافٍ.

quranTranslation.text: And of mankind are some who say: We believe in Allah and the Last Day, when they believe not.

explanation.bs: „…a oni nikako nisu vjernici“ – بِمُؤْمِنِينَ.
explanation.en: “…when they believe not” – بِمُؤْمِنِينَ.

quranTranslation.text: I worship not that which ye worship;

explanation.bs: „Ne obožavam…“ – أَعْبُدُ ostaje u indikativu.
explanation.en: “I worship not…” – أَعْبُدُ stays indicative.

quranTranslation.text: As for the Disbelievers, Whether thou warn them or thou warn them not it is all one for them; they believe not.

explanation.bs: „…oni ne vjeruju“.
explanation.en: “…they believe not”.

quranTranslation.text: Therefor the orphan oppress not,

explanation.bs: „Pa siroče nemoj tlačiti“ – تَقْهَرْ u jusivu.
explanation.en: “Therefor the orphan oppress not” – تَقْهَرْ is jussive.

quranTranslation.text: Therefor obey not thou the rejecters

explanation.bs: „Pa ne pokoravaj se poricateljima“ – تُطِعِ u jusivu (kesra samo zbog izgovora uz ٱلْ).
explanation.en: “Therefor obey not thou the rejecters” – تُطِعِ is jussive (the kasra only joins it to ٱلْ).

quranTranslation.text: We said: Go down, all of you, from hence; but verily there cometh unto you from Me a guidance; and whoso followeth My guidance, there shall no fear come upon them neither shall they grieve.

explanation.bs: „…nad njima neće biti straha, niti će oni tugovati“ – خَوْفٌ u nominativu.
explanation.en: “…there shall no fear come upon them neither shall they grieve” – خَوْفٌ is nominative.

quranTranslation.text: In gardens and watersprings.

explanation.bs: „…u baščama i među izvorima“.
explanation.en: “In gardens and watersprings”.

quranTranslation.text: On a guarded tablet.

explanation.bs: „…na brižno čuvanoj Ploči“.
explanation.en: “On a guarded tablet”.

quranTranslation.text: Remember Allah through the appointed days. Then whoso hasteneth (his departure) by two days, it is no sin for him, and whoso delayeth, it is no sin for him; that is for him who wardeth off (evil). Be careful of your duty to Allah, and know that unto Him ye will be gathered.

explanation.bs: „I spominjite Allaha u izbrojanim danima“.
explanation.en: “Remember Allah through the appointed days”.

quranTranslation.text: Within ten years - Allah's is the command in the former case and in the latter - and in that day believers will rejoice

explanation.bs: „…za nekoliko godina“.
explanation.en: Within a few years (بِضْعِ: three to nine) – فِي of time.

quranTranslation.text: O ye who believe! If ye help Allah, He will help you and will make your foothold firm.

explanation.bs: „Ako Allahu pomognete, pomoći će i On vama“ – oba glagola u jusivu.
explanation.en: “If ye help Allah, He will help you” – both verbs jussive.

quranTranslation.text: (Fast) a certain number of days; and (for) him who is sick among you, or on a journey, (the same) number of other days; and for those who can afford it there is a ransom: the feeding of a man in need - but whoso doeth good of his own accord, it is better for him: and that ye fast is better for you if ye did but know -

explanation.bs: „A da postite – to je za vas bolje“ – تَصُومُوا u subjunktivu.
explanation.en: “That ye fast is better for you” – تَصُومُوا is subjunctive.

quranTranslation.text: Allah would make the burden light for you, for man was created weak.

explanation.bs: „Allah hoće da vam teret olakša“ – أَن يُخَفِّفَ, u subjunktivu.
explanation.en: “Allah would make the burden light for you” – أَن يُخَفِّفَ, subjunctive.

quranTranslation.text: Allah it is Who hath revealed the Scripture with truth, and the Balance. How canst thou know? It may be that the Hour is nigh.

explanation.bs: „A otkud ti znaš? Možda je Čas blizu“ – ٱلسَّاعَةَ u akuzativu, قَرِيبٌ u nominativu.
explanation.en: “How canst thou know? It may be that the Hour is nigh” – ٱلسَّاعَةَ is accusative, قَرِيبٌ nominative.

gloss.en: The noun after it is accusative

quranTranslation.text: Ye will not attain unto piety until ye spend of that which ye love. And whatsoever ye spend, Allah is Aware thereof.

explanation.bs: „Nećete dostići dobrotu dok ne udijelite…“ – تَنَالُوا u subjunktivu.
explanation.en: “Ye will not attain unto piety until ye spend…” – تَنَالُوا is subjunctive.

quranTranslation.text: And if ye do it not - and ye can never do it - then guard yourselves against the Fire prepared for disbelievers, whose fuel is of men and stones.

explanation.bs: „…a nećete to ni učiniti“.
explanation.en: وَلَن تَفْعَلُوا: “and ye can never do it”.

quranTranslation.text: And had it not been for the favour of my Lord, I too had been of those haled forth (to doom).

explanation.bs: „Da nije blagodati mog Gospodara, i ja bih bio među dovedenima.“
explanation.en: “And had it not been for the favour of my Lord, I too had been of those haled forth (to doom).”

quranTranslation.text: And had it not been for the grace of Allah and His mercy unto you, and that Allah is Clement, Wise, (ye had been undone).

explanation.bs: „I da vam nije Allahove blagodati i Njegove milosti…“ – فَضْلُ u nominativu.
explanation.en: “And had it not been for the grace of Allah and His mercy unto you…” – فَضْلُ is nominative.

quranTranslation.text: We created you. Will ye then admit the truth?

explanation.bs: „Mi smo vas stvorili, pa zašto onda ne vjerujete?“
explanation.en: “We created you” – then فَلَوْلَا تُصَدِّقُونَ: why, then, do you not believe?

quranTranslation.text: The best among them said: Said I not unto you: Why glorify ye not (Allah)?

explanation.bs: „…Zar vam nisam rekao: Zašto ne slavite (Allaha)?“
explanation.en: “…Said I not unto you: Why glorify ye not (Allah)?”

quranTranslation.text: And, by Allah, I shall circumvent your idols after ye have gone away and turned your backs.

explanation.bs: „I, tako mi Allaha, smislit ću lukavstvo protiv vaših kipova…“ – Ibrahimova zakletva; po az-Zamaḫšarīju u njoj je čuđenje.
explanation.en: “And, by Allah, I shall circumvent your idols…” – Abraham's oath; for az-Zamaḫšarī it carries wonder.

quranTranslation.text: They said: By Allah, thou wilt never cease remembering Joseph till thy health is ruined or thou art of those who perish!

explanation.bs: „Rekoše: Tako nam Allaha, ti nećeš prestati spominjati Jusufa dok sasvim ne iznemogneš…“
explanation.en: “They said: By Allah, thou wilt never cease remembering Joseph till thy health is ruined…”

quranTranslation.text: And they assign a portion of that which We have given them unto what they know not. By Allah! but ye will indeed be asked concerning (all) that ye used to invent.

explanation.bs: „Tako mi Allaha, zaista ćete biti pitani o onome što ste izmišljali!“
explanation.en: “By Allah! but ye will indeed be asked concerning (all) that ye used to invent.”

quranTranslation.text: That we may glorify Thee much

explanation.bs: „da Te mnogo slavimo“ – نُسَبِّحَكَ u subjunktivu.
explanation.en: “That we may glorify Thee much” – نُسَبِّحَكَ is subjunctive.

quranTranslation.text: So We restored him to his mother that she might be comforted and not grieve, and that she might know that the promise of Allah is true. But most of them know not.

explanation.bs: „Tako smo ga vratili njegovoj majci da joj se oko obraduje…“ – تَقَرَّ u subjunktivu.
explanation.en: “So We restored him to his mother that she might be comforted…” – تَقَرَّ is subjunctive.
